name: Full Taxi
tagline: Rider and driver taxi apps for the Full Services platform in Uzbekistan
role: Rider and driver apps by the Softwhere team for Full Services

scenes.title: Riders order inside Full Services
scenes.body: Taxi sits beside food, market and listings; each tariff is priced per km of the route.

scenes.title: Order status, from search to fare
scenes.body: Polls every 5 s: driver and car details, one-tap call, then fare plus waiting.

scenes.title: Driver app: shifts and live offers
scenes.body: Start a shift; offers arrive with a sound, fare, distance and a 15 s accept timer.

scenes.title: Paid waiting and a taximeter mode
scenes.body: A stopwatch bills waiting by the minute; the taximeter adds up GPS distance every 4 s.

scenes.title: Fare summary and trip history
scenes.body: Rides close with fare plus waiting; history lists route, price and distance.
